title: A flailing war, and a war secretary measuring manhood
body: Nearly two weeks into the war with Iran and there's no win to point to. Oil is past $100, the Strait of Hormuz is effectively closed, and Iran says US strikes have killed more than 50 people while its own attacks keep hitting ships and bases. American service members are dead. The Pentagon quietly admitted close to 100 troops were injured after first leaving them off the count. Hegseth told the Senate the war has already cost $37.5 billion. Pressed on it this week, he snapped "You have Trump derangement syndrome" at a senator rather than explain why his earlier claims of victory were premature.

So what is the Secretary of War focused on? Testosterone. The Intercept's Nick Turse lays out how Hegseth has ordered mandatory annual hormone screening for every troop over 30, women included, and called topping off their levels a "sacred duty." He wants a "High-T" force. He posts workout videos. He rails against "fat generals" and "Pentagon pussies," blocks the promotion of women officers, and pushed out trans troops. His own department offered senators no evidence any of it improves readiness.
